originalTitle: JFrog, Bandwidth, Qualys, Asure Software, and DigitalOcean Stocks Trade Up, What You Need To Know
summary: A number of stocks jumped in the morning session after technology equities rebounded from a sharp sell-off sparked by concerns over artificial intelligence revenue expansion.
content:
A number of stocks jumped in the morning session after technology equities rebounded from a sharp sell-off sparked by concerns over artificial intelligence revenue expansion.

Major equity averages, including the S&P 500 and the tech-heavy Nasdaq, moved higher at the open on Friday as market sentiment stabilized. Just a day earlier, shares across the artificial intelligence and broader technology space had faced heightened selling pressure following an OpenAI revenue report that rattled investor confidence regarding near-term monetization in the AI sector. However, the pullback proved short-lived as dip-buyers re-entered the market, viewing the valuation reset as an attractive entry point.

The swift recovery highlights enduring investor appetite for leading technology firms, even as Wall Street remains sensitive to updates on how quickly massive capital investments in artificial intelligence will translate into sustainable corporate profits.

The stock market overreacts to news, and big price drops can present good opportunities to buy high-quality stocks.

Among others, the following stocks were impacted:

Data Storage company DigitalOcean(NYSE:DOCN) jumped 4.7%.Is now the time to buy DigitalOcean? Access our full analysis report here, it's free.

DigitalOcean's shares are extremely volatile and have had 71 moves greater than 5% over the last year. In that context, today's move indicates the market considers this news meaningful but not something that would fundamentally change its perception of the business.

The previous big move we wrote about was 11 days ago when the stock dropped 2.5% on the news that a deepening Treasury selloff and higher oil prices pushed the benchmark 10-year yield to 5.218%, reinforcing expectations of further Federal Reserve rate hikes. Morningstar reported that stocks slid and technology shares led early declines as the week began, a week that also includes key jobs data. A Treasury selloff means investors are selling U.S. government bonds.

When bond prices fall, their yields, or the return investors receive, rise. Higher yields tend to weigh heavily on technology and software stocks. Much of the value of these companies is based on profits expected many years into the future. When investors can earn more than 5% on relatively safe government bonds, those distant earnings become less attractive in comparison, which can lower the prices investors are willing to pay for growth stocks.

Rising oil prices add to the pressure because they can push inflation higher. Persistent inflation could lead the Federal Reserve to keep raising interest rates, increasing borrowing costs for businesses and consumers. The upcoming jobs report may give investors more clues about the Fed's next steps.

DigitalOcean is up 168% since the beginning of the year, but at $131.28 per share, it is still trading 27.6% below its 52-week high of $181.29 from June 2026. Investors who bought $1,000 worth of DigitalOcean's shares 5 years ago would now be looking at an investment worth $1,565.

chineseTitle: JFrog、Bandwidth、Qualys、Asure Software 和 DigitalOcean 股票上涨，您需要了解什么
chineseSummary: 由于对人工智能收入扩张的担忧引发的大幅抛售，科技股从大幅抛售中反弹，许多股票在早盘上涨。
chineseContent:
由于对人工智能收入扩张的担忧引发的大幅抛售，科技股从大幅抛售中反弹，许多股票在早盘上涨。

随着市场情绪企稳，包括标准普尔 500 指数和以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数在内的主要股指周五开盘走高。就在一天前，OpenAI 的一份收入报告动摇了投资者对人工智能领域近期货币化的信心，导致人工智能和更广泛技术领域的股票面临更大的抛售压力。然而，事实证明，回调是短暂的，因为抄底买家重新进入市场，将估值重置视为有吸引力的切入点。

快速复苏突显了投资者对领先科技公司的持久兴趣，尽管华尔街仍然对人工智能领域的大规模资本投资将多快转化为可持续企业利润的最新消息敏感。

股市对消息反应过度，价格大幅下跌可能是购买优质股票的好机会。

DigitalOcean 的股价波动极大，去年有 71 次涨幅超过 5%。在这种背景下，今天的举动表明市场认为这一消息有意义，但不会从根本上改变其对该业务的看法。

我们之前写到的重大波动是在 11 天前，当时有消息称美国国债抛售加剧和油价上涨将基准 10 年期国债收益率推至 5.218%，强化了美联储进一步加息的预期，导致该股下跌 2.5%。晨星报告称，本周初股市下跌，科技股领跌，本周还公布了关键就业数据。美国国债抛售意味着投资者正在抛售美国政府债券。

当债券价格下跌时，其收益率或投资者获得的回报就会上升。较高的收益率往往会给科技股和软件股带来沉重压力。这些公司的大部分价值是基于未来多年的预期利润。当投资者可以通过相对安全的政府债券赚取超过 5% 的收益时，相比之下，那些遥远的收益就变得不那么有吸引力，这可能会降低投资者愿意为成长型股票支付的价格。

油价上涨增加了压力，因为它们会推高通胀。持续的通货膨胀可能导致美联储继续加息，从而增加企业和消费者的借贷成本。即将发布的就业报告可能会给投资者提供有关美联储下一步行动的更多线索。

DigitalOcean 自今年年初以来上涨了 168%，但每股 131.28 美元，仍比 2026 年 6 月以来的 52 周高点 181.29 美元低 27.6%。 5 年前购买了价值 1,000 美元的 DigitalOcean 股票的投资者现在将考虑价值 1,565 美元的投资。
